exposure: Preterm births classified as indicated based on birth certificate data
Preterm births classified as spontaneous based on birth certificate data
Preterm birth classified as spontaneous or indicated
outcome: Accuracy of preterm birth classification (spontaneous vs. indicated)
cohort: The study included 123 birth certificates from preterm births in Missouri.
finding: Birth certificate classification overestimated spontaneous preterm birth and underestimated indicated preterm birth compared to classification based on medical record review.
